title: Breville the Bambino Plus Coffee Machine (Pomodoro Rosso) $447 (RRP $729) Delivered @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: Breville the Bambino Plus Coffee Machine (Pomodoro Rosso) $447 (RRP $729) Delivered @ Amazon AU

[clandestino] "The 54mm porta-filter with 19 grams is the key for full flavour and cafe quality coffee"
Can anyone recommend an accurate set of scales?
I reckon 18grams is too much for this 54mm portafilter.
[Gunnar] Isn’t one of the best things to do with this machine is to change the portafilter to a bottomless one so you’re not using the pressurised one that comes with this?
[78zeros] These machines come with four baskets - 1 & 2 Cup Single & Dual Wall Filter Baskets
[retainer] Correct.
I purchased the Breville 54mm naked portafilter and paired it with an IMS basket. https://amzn.asia/d/0dZmdXkV
Also still rocking this deal https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/911877
[lawyerz] Which ims basket did you get? What's your experience with it?
[retainer] @lawyerz: See above link
Works very good
[lawyerz] @retainer: Yes there a variants of height and shape of IMS basket. The link lands on h24 so the 24mm height one?
[clandestino] I've been using a non-pressurised portafilter for the past few years. But 18-19grams is still too much for a 54mm portafilter in my experience.
Anyway, what does your "bottomless portafilter" comment have to do with my question? lol
[lawyerz] Mm I've no issue with the 54mm with either the stock filter or aftermarket filter
[DonkyWonky] 18g is recommended by breville, 19g may work depending on roast density of coffee.
[clandestino] That's what the manual says, for my old "bambino plus"…
… so I was intrigued to read the comment on the Amazon listing, seems like a load of old balls: "The 54mm porta-filter with 19 grams is the key for full flavour and cafe quality coffee"
[Solrak] You can fit 18 grams in but not much more.
[spad] how many grams of coffee does cafe use for a standard size latte?
